thread:
maya: Kicking off dedicated pool bring-up for ZenithWave. Need a short runbook owner, quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and a dry-run load test this week. Who can take the lead on the test harness and metrics dashboard?

riley: I can own the load test harness and metrics. Planning to reuse the nighthawk script with token-bucket emulation.

jonas: I'll handle autoscale thresholds and the fallback policy. Quick question — do we want conservative initial thresholds (to avoid thrash) or aggressive to prove throughput?

maya: Conservative for first pass. Customer's production traffic has a lot of spiky tails. We should prove steady-state + a 2x spike scenario.

samir: Agree. Also need to validate quota enforcement behaviors. Customer will be bursty and they use client retries. Can we coordinate expected client retry windows and rate limits?

riley: Yes. Proposed test plan: 3 phases
1) steady 10m at target throughput (baseline)
2) 2x burst for 3m with client retries enabled
3) recovery window and traffic shift to fallback model for 5m
I'll post exact commands.

jonas: For autoscale, propose: scale-up trigger = 70% GPU util OR queue length > 8k for 30s; scale-down hold = 5m after going below 40%. Canary fallback to smaller quantized model if scale-up fails twice in 10m.

maya: Nice. Samir pls confirm quota numbers from contract — reserved tokens/min and allowed burst. We also need to confirm KMS rotation window so we don't rekey during the test.

samir: Contracted reserved RPS: 1200 req/min (sustained). Burst allowance: up to 3600 req/min for 5m. KMS rotation: nightly at 03:00 UTC, so avoid that window.

riley: Load command (local harness) — vegeta for HTTP gen, then analyze latency p95/p99:
```
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=60 -duration=10m | vegeta report -type=hist
# for spike: rate=360 
```
I'll include client retry header simulation and randomized payload sizes.

maya: Great. Can we also capture token-level cost and per-model latency breakdown in the dashboard? Need those for the QBR.

riley: Yes — I'll wire metrics to the console dashboard: token_count, model_id, latency_p50/p95/p99, error_rate, request_size.

jonas: One more item: warmup KV cache. Recommend running a priming pass to populate common prefixes before the baseline test. 10-15% of traffic with high-prefix overlap should do it.

maya: Good call. Add a priming phase before steady-state. Samir — can we schedule the customer-facing runbook review tomorrow 11:00 PT?

samir: 11:00 PT works for me. I'll pull contract excerpts and send the quota table.

maya: Ops-bot — create a temporary runbook channel and add the oncall for tomorrow's window @riley @jonas @samir

ops-bot: Created channel #cs-zenith-bringup-3712345678 and invited riley, jonas, samir. Runbook template uploaded at /runbooks/zenith-bringup-v1.md

riley: I'll prepare the harness and a short smoke script (5m) to run in staging today so we can iterate. Posting results after the run.

jonas: I'll stage the autoscale policy in staging and tag the canary route. Also will set the fallback model mapping per policy.

maya: Perfect. Aim to have staging smoke results + runbook draft before the 11:00 PT review. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
